latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Code review bot: post the rest of a review when part of it is held back by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14576
* Have the issue enrichment bot set issue types instead of Type: Bug labels by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14577
* Give the code review bot linked issues' type, and drop Type: Bug from examples and fixtures by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14578
* Code review bot: skip issues a PR only mentions, and call suggestions suggestions by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14579
* Code review bot: make the review summary short by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14580
* Code review report: count suggestions from the review's status line by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14582
* Connect the store-counts cron job to the DB through pgbouncer (port 6432) by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14573
* Close integration test async DB pool in fixture teardown by @pranshup04 in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14581
* Make the FastAPI /health endpoint async so it doesn't wait for the threadpool by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14584
* Log invalid user search queries at debug level without a traceback by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14586
* Look up archive.org metadata off the event loop in /api/volumes by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14585
* Set the client IP for Infobase writes from FastAPI login and anonymize by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14589
* Remove dead endpoint /search/languages by @pranshup04 in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14560
* Filter batch import items by status or error from the summary by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14590
* Log importbot in once and share the session with its workers by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14587
* Export per-request backend time as a Prometheus histogram by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14600
* Add a segmented status progress bar to batch import pages by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14599
* Editing Stats: count edition and work edits, add New editors, link community projects by @lokesh in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14604
* Update to solr 10.1.0 by @cdrini in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14603
* Drop the deleted Type: Bug / Type: Feature Request labels from the enrichment prompt by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14610
* Code review bot: let a PR's author re-run the review with the re-request button by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14611
* Justify pull_request_target on the PR labeler workflows instead of FIX ME by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14613
* Code review bot: retry a GitHub 5xx when posting the review by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14612
* Code review bot: review base-branch updates, and skip files that already match master by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14614
* Remove legacy genres field from edition model by @hornc in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/13948
* Add the Weblate URL to the i18n pipeline doc and fix how its PRs merge by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14619
* i18n: keep one %% in the contribute ring's done label by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14620
* i18n: make five split sentences whole translatable strings by @RayBB in https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/pull/14618
* Require the add-book captcha for accounts un
